title: Confirmer un Retard de Transport
wrap_friend: 你剛剛完成了一段 A2 交通服務情境，確認重點並做出簡單回應。
learner_goal: Understand a delay duration and choose whether to wait or take another route.
register_notes: French public transport/service language with polite everyday responses; no refund, legal, medical, police, or identity-sensitive handling.
support_text: Demandez au personnel de la gare des informations sur un retard, confirmez la durée et choisissez une prochaine étape simple.

turns.translation: 對，開往 Central 的列車晚 15 分鐘。

notes.scenario_realism_repair_20260615: Reframed from a broadcast-to-dialogue hybrid into a station-staff information request flow: staff states the delay, learner confirms it, staff offers wait/bus options, and the bus option may end the dialogue.
